_comment: Canonical village-enemy stat blocks for Defenders of the Realm v2 (Unity port). Two FAMILIES share one codex: (1) the HOLLOW ONES — the KayKit skeleton undead who march on Elarion in the wave loop (family 'hollow'); (2) the ORC WARBAND — the Tripo orc greenskins of the overworld (family 'orc' = the codex's 'Wildlands' living faction, enemy-codex.md S1.2). Hollow stats are sourced VERBATIM from the React v1 enemyArchetypes.ts (KAY_ENEMIES + NECROMANCER, with ENEMY_HP_BUFF x2 + ENEMY_DAMAGE_BUFF +40% already baked). Orc stats are agent-authored to the same resolved scale, tuned to their overworld role (roaming raiders + camp garrisons that guard reclaimable resource nodes). moveSpeed is NavMeshAgent units/sec; contactDamage is per-hit damage to a building/wall/gate; attackInterval is seconds between melee hits.

_sources.portSpec: defenders-unity/docs/v2-unity-port-spec.md (Part 3 enemies row, Part 4 enemies.json schema, Week 4 'Wave 1 = 8 Hollow Walkers')
_sources.hollowMeshes: Assets/Resources/Enemies/ — AccuRig family (Skeleton_Mage / Skeleton_Warrior / Skeleton_Rogue / Skeleton_Healer) + KayKit legacy (Skeleton_Minion / Skeleton_Golem / Necromancer)
_sources.orcMeshes: defenders-unity/Assets/Models/People/Orc/*.fbx (Orc_Berserker / Orc_Shaman / orc necromancer) -> wired into Resources/Enemies/ as Humanoid (shared Tripo rig, retargets the Assets/Action Mixamo library)

_schemaNotes.id: Stable enemy id - the wave-data 'type' field keys into this. Also the ENEMY_DEFS bridge key the breach trigger maps to the ATB engine.
_schemaNotes.family: Faction the enemy belongs to: 'hollow' (the undead skeleton wave faction - marches on Elarion's gates) or 'orc' (the living Orc Warband - overworld roamers + reclaimable-camp garrisons). Drives spawn context: hollow = village wave siege, orc = overworld roam / camp-clear-for-node. Absent = 'hollow' for back-compat.
_schemaNotes.role: Combat archetype within the family: 'grunt' (basic melee), 'brute' (heavy melee/tank), 'skirmisher' (fast flanker), 'caster' (ranged/support), 'elite' (camp boss / mini-boss). Used by spawners to pick mix + by the codex to balance a warband.
_schemaNotes.spawn: Where this enemy appears: 'wave' (village gate siege), 'roam' (wanders an overworld region), 'camp' (garrisons a reclaimable node-camp; cleared to claim the node). A list; an enemy can do more than one. Hollow Ones default to ['wave'].
_schemaNotes.ai: 'walker' (straight march toward the Heart, melee on contact), 'charger' (faster, ignores buildings), 'skirmisher' (fast, picks weakest wall/target). Wave-1 foundation ships 'walker' only; others are authored for later waves + the orc overworld.
_schemaNotes.modelKey: Mesh key under Resources/Enemies/<key>.fbx. Hollow silhouettes = AccuRig CC_Base (Mage/Warrior/Rogue/Healer) or KayKit legacy (Minion/Golem/Necromancer). Orc = Humanoid Tripo. AUTHORITY (WO-954, 2026-08-14): this field is the FIRST authority on which model an id wears, for EVERY family - not just the Hollows. EnemyFactory.ModelForEnemy honours it whenever the key names a mesh in EnemyResolver.CommittedModels (the committed Resources/Enemies registry); the code switch in EnemyFactory is now only the LAST-RESORT fallback, for ids with no row here and for keys whose art is not imported. A key that is NOT committed is REJECTED by name in the trace and the code stand-in is used, so a typo can never spawn a tinted capsule. As seeded this changes no spawn: every row whose key is committed already matched the code switch. The one art-pending key is ogre -> OgreMage (no OgreMage.fbx exists; stand-in Orc_Shaman), declared in EnemyResolverRegression.artPendingModelKeys.
_schemaNotes.hp: Resolved max hit points (hollow values include the React global ENEMY_HP_BUFF x2).
_schemaNotes.contactDamage: Damage one melee hit deals to a building / wall / gate (or the hero in the overworld).
_schemaNotes.attackInterval: Seconds between melee hits while in contact.
_schemaNotes.height: Approximate mesh height (world units) - sizes the NavMeshAgent capsule + the floating HP bar offset.
_schemaNotes.boss: true for a faction wave-boss (the Necromancer of the Wound). Orc 'elite' camp-bosses are role='elite', not boss=true (they lead a camp, not a village wave).
_schemaNotes.rewardVariance: WO-1103 - bounded kill-reward variance as a fraction (0.15 = +/-15%). At grant time xp/gold roll value * (1 + Random.Range(-v, +v)), rounded (EnemyDef.RollReward - the one authority). Absent = 0 = deterministic. Seeded 0.15 for regular enemies / 0.10 for bosses as an opening balance - a TUNABLE the owner re-balances per row, never a lock.

enemies.name: Hollow Walker
enemies.flavor: A risen villager of the Hollow Ones - slow, certain, and without memory of the home it marches on.

enemies.name: Hollow Warrior
enemies.flavor: Armored bone in a weighted march — a wall of the dead that does not hurry and does not break.

enemies.name: Hollow Rogue
enemies.flavor: Quick and low to the ground - it slips the line and goes for the weakest ward.

enemies.name: Hollow Acolyte
enemies.flavor: A robed thing that hums the dirge of the Wound — it mends the bone of its kin faster than you can break it. Cut it down first.

enemies.name: Hollow Mage
enemies.flavor: A staff-bearing skeleton wreathed in Withering violet — it looses bolts of grief from the back of the march.

enemies.name: Hollow Reaper
enemies.flavor: A tall, dark-tinted Warrior with the scythe — the Hollow Ones' executioner. When it wades in, the line is in trouble.

enemies.name: Hollow Brute
enemies.flavor: Many of the Hollowed fused into one bone-construct, an oversized axe in its grip. Slow, but it charges the Heart and ignores what is in its way.

enemies.name: Cellar Hollow
enemies.flavor: A villager who fled to the cellar long ago and was taken by the Withering where it hid. It kneels and rocks rather than wanders. They are grief, not menace.

enemies.name: The Apprentice of the Apothecary
enemies.flavor: A skeleton in a stained healer's apron, a glass vial clutched in one hand. It still performs the motions of healing — it does not know it is dead.

enemies.name: Alduin's Necromancer
enemies.flavor: A hand of Alduin the Mournful. Where it walks, the Hollowed rise to walk beside it.

enemies.name: Orc Berserker
enemies.flavor: The Warband's front line - no patience, all axe. It hits the wall it sees, not the one that's weakest.

enemies.name: Orc Shaman
enemies.flavor: Keeps to the back of the camp and mends what the Berserkers break. Drop it first.

enemies.name: Orc Necromancer
enemies.flavor: The elite that holds a Warband camp. Clear it and the node it squats on is yours to reclaim.

enemies.name: Orc Raider
enemies.flavor: The Warband's roving muscle - a greenskin raider who hunts the open Wildlands and garrisons the reclaimable camps. SINGLE-SOURCE stat block: whether it roams, guards an outpost, mounts a camp counterattack, or staffs a garrison, it reads these exact base stats (each spawner still scales by its own context).

enemies.name: Cave Troll
enemies.flavor: A lumbering brute of the deep places - slow, but each blow lands like a falling oak.

enemies.name: Troll Stonecaller
enemies.flavor: Hurls the mountain at you a piece at a time. Slower to swing than its kin, and it never needs to.

enemies.name: Troll Bonesinger
enemies.flavor: It does not fight you. It sings the wounds back out of the ones who do - faster than you can put them in.

enemies.name: Troll Overlord
enemies.flavor: The one the others follow down. It does not charge - it arrives, and the ground gives it room.

enemies.name: Ogre
enemies.flavor: A hulking ogre dragged up from the warrens - it swings a whole tree and calls it a club.
